major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this as your main offensive cooldown off cooldown as soon as it is up, unless you are holding it as a defensive for a known dangerous upcoming damage window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide names this talent as spell 394786; the abilities table verifies the current cast id as 102558 with the same name.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this as your main offensive cooldown when your build does not take Incarnation, timing it the same way around Thrash and cat-form weaving windows.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not named directly in the guide text, but present in the APL as the alternative hero-talent main cooldown to Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast this while in Bear Form so it contributes to your tanking output; do not cast it while shifted into Cat Form.

major_cooldowns.name: Red Moon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast this on cooldown in place of Moonfire to keep the dot maintained, ideally lining it up close to a Mangle cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown, but hold it briefly when Incarnation or Berserk is about to come off cooldown so the two line up together.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide gives an effective cooldown around 60s; table base_cd_s of 60 matches.

major_cooldowns.name: Heart of the Wild
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Shift into Cat Form roughly every two minutes to cast this when it is safe; skipping it or catweaving further beyond this single cast is a DPS loss.
major_cooldowns.id_note: NOT observed in the sampled parses, but the guide explicitly names it as a button to press in Cat Form; talent-gated.

defensives.name: Frenzied Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Use this to heal yourself through bleed or magic damage, since Ironfur's armor does not mitigate those damage types.
defensives.id_note: Table base_cd_s of 36 is used; guide does not state a different effective cooldown.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Use this on cooldown while in Bear Form to smooth incoming damage; with the Brambles talent it also deals damage back.
defensives.id_note: Guide describes it as a 40-60s cooldown; table base_cd_s of 60 is used as the untalented value.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: Save this for the most dangerous damage intake or the biggest hits rather than spending it reactively on cooldown.
defensives.id_note: Guide notes two charges baseline; table base_cd_s of 180 is the per-charge cooldown.

defensives.name: Bristling Fur
defensives.usage_rule: Use this ahead of a burst of incoming damage so it converts that damage into rage while active.

rules.description: Convoke the Spirits only in Bear Form
rules.action: Only press Convoke the Spirits while shapeshifted into Bear Form.
Shift back into Bear Form before pressing Barkskin so it applies to your tanking mitigation.

rules.description: Heart of the Wild only in Cat Form
rules.action: Shift into Cat Form before casting Heart of the Wild so it applies the intended dot.

rules.description: Hold Lunar Beam for Incarnation or Berserk
rules.action: Delay Lunar Beam slightly when Incarnation or Berserk is about to come off cooldown so the two line up together.

rules.description: Keep Thrash up on your target
rules.action: Refresh Thrash whenever it is missing or its stacks are dropping instead of letting it fall off.
Only fill with Swipe when several enemies are up; use single-target filler otherwise.

rules.description: Pool rage before spending it on Ironfur
rules.action: Wait until your rage is high enough before pressing Ironfur instead of spending it as soon as it is available.
